main_body: two wooden crates with metal corner brackets
top_band: light tan and medium brown horizontal plank bands from row 0 to row 8 on the larger crate (rows 8-14 on the smaller crate)
evidence: The larger crate shows a clear 9px top surface (rows 0-8) made of horizontal planks, ending in a lighter front edge at row 7-8, followed by a 10px darker front face (rows 9-18) with a dark eave shadow at row 9 and an inset panel with a diagonal brace. The smaller crate similarly has a 7px top (rows 8-14) and an 8px front face (rows 15-22).

style.evidence: The crates use a 5-step brown wood ramp plus a 2-step grey metal corner bracket ramp, with dark brown material outlines rather than pure black (except the ground drop shadow). Plank lines, inset shadows, and diagonal braces break up the surfaces so there are no large flat fills, though the straight horizontal stripes on the top lack some of the organic pixel grain of the Beodeul references.
